black.note: Primary surface. LeanCode is black-first; yellow is the exception.

white.note: Text and headings on black; the light document surface.

ctaYellow.note: Call to action and emphasis only. Text on it is always black.

mutedGray.note: Secondary text, captions, metadata on dark.

mutedOnLight.note: Secondary text, captions, metadata on light: the design system's #757575, a step darker so it also reads AA on paper.

surface.note: Cards and panels on black, warm-tinted.

surface2.note: A second surface step on black.

nearBlack.note: Site tint: a section background a step above black.

paper.note: Site tint: a section background a step below white.

paper2.note: Site tint: a second surface step on white.

bodyOnLight.note: Site tint: body copy on light surfaces.

lineStrongOnLight.note: Site tint: the stronger hairline on white, for controls.

ctaYellowLight.note: Site tint: the CTA yellow lifted, for the primary button's hover.

ctaYellowOnLight.note: Site tint: the CTA yellow as text on white, which yellow itself never is.

errorOnLight.note: Site tint: the error signal as text on white.

successOnLight.note: Site tint: the success signal as text on white.

tokens.surface2: Bars and chips on a surface.
tokens.accent: The CTA yellow, as a fill.
tokens.accentSoft: The accent as a wash behind icons, pills and glows.
